mapper.select: SELECT * FROM members WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM members WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND mobile = #{mobileEnc} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM members WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND mobile = #{mobileEnc} LIMIT 1
mapper.sql:
FROM members m LEFT JOIN members_info info ON m.company_id = info.company_id AND m.user_id = info.user_id
LEFT JOIN members_rel_shop shop ON shop.user_id = m.user_id AND shop.company_id = m.company_id LEFT JOIN wxshops s ON shop.shop_id = s.wx_shop_id
LEFT JOIN members_rel_tags reltags ON reltags.user_id = m.user_id AND reltags.company_id = m.company_id
mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT m.user_id, m.company_id, m.grade_id, m.mobile, m.user_card_code, m.authorizer_appid, m.wxa_appid, m.source_id, m.monitor_id, m.latest_source_id, m.latest_monitor_id, m.created, m.updated, m.created_year, m.created_month, m.created_day, m.offline_card_code, m.inviter_id, m.source_from, m.password, m.disabled, m.use_point, m.remarks, m.third_data, m.region_mobile, m.mobile_country_code, m.reg_distributor, m.reg_salesperson, m.fp_salesperson, m.has_fp, m.op_distributor, info.username, info.name, info.sex, info.birthday, info.address, info.email, info.industry, info.income, info.edu_background, info.habbit, info.avatar, wx.unionid AS unionid, wx.open_id AS open_id
, shop.shop_id AS shop_id , s.store_name AS store_name
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ma.company_id, ma.user_id, ma.unionid, w.open_id FROM members_associations ma INNER JOIN ( SELECT company_id, user_id, MIN(id) AS id FROM members_associations WHERE user_type = 'wechat' GROUP BY company_id, user_id ) ma_pick ON ma_pick.id = ma.id LEFT JOIN members_wechatusers w ON w.company_id = ma.company_id AND w.unionid = ma.unionid ) wx ON wx.company_id = m.company_id AND wx.user_id = m.user_id
ORDER BY m.user_id DESC
mapper.sql: SELECT DISTINCT m.user_id, m.company_id, m.grade_id, m.mobile, m.user_card_code, m.authorizer_appid, m.wxa_appid, m.source_id, m.monitor_id, m.latest_source_id, m.latest_monitor_id, m.created, m.updated, m.created_year, m.created_month, m.created_day, m.offline_card_code, m.inviter_id, m.source_from, m.password, m.disabled, m.use_point, m.remarks, m.third_data, m.region_mobile, m.mobile_country_code, m.reg_distributor, m.reg_salesperson, m.fp_salesperson, m.has_fp, m.op_distributor, info.username, info.name, info.sex, info.birthday, info.address, info.email, info.industry, info.income, info.edu_background, info.habbit, info.avatar, (SELECT ma.unionid FROM members_associations ma WHERE ma.company_id = m.company_id AND ma.user_id = m.user_id AND ma.user_type = 'wechat' LIMIT 1) AS unionid, (SELECT w.open_id FROM members_associations ma2 INNER JOIN members_wechatusers w ON w.company_id = ma2.company_id AND w.unionid = ma2.unionid WHERE ma2.company_id = m.company_id AND ma2.user_id = m.user_id AND ma2.user_type = 'wechat' LIMIT 1) AS open_id
mapper.select: SELECT member.user_id AS user_id, member.mobile AS mobile, info.username AS username FROM members member LEFT JOIN members_info info ON member.company_id = info.company_id AND member.user_id = info.user_id WHERE member.company_id = #{companyId} AND member.mobile = #{mobileEnc}

SELECT m.user_id AS user_id, m.mobile AS mobile, i.username AS username FROM members m LEFT JOIN members_info i ON m.company_id = i.company_id AND m.user_id = i.user_id WHERE m.company_id = #{companyId} AND m.user_id IN #{uid}
